title: SALMON: SELF-ALIGNMENT WITH INSTRUCTABLE REWARD MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation of harmlessness using the Anthropic HHH (Helpful, Honest, Harmless) multiple-choice evaluation set, which tests the model's ability to reject discriminatory, prejudiced, or stereotyping content.
Qualitative evaluation of model responses to adversarial red-teaming prompts containing explicit intersectional stereotypes (e.g., stereotypes about Black women).
Qualitative evaluation of model responses to red-teaming prompts querying harmful stereotypes about the intelligence of specific professions or groups (e.g., professional football players).
